title: 'Designing the in-between' — dark precise motion reel with one orange dot
summary: A 15 s, single-take motion reel on a near-black canvas where one vermilion dot is the hero: it rides a cubic-bezier curve, becomes the dot on the i of 'motion', 'timing' and the italic serif 'feeling', inflates into a toggle switch, stretches into a 'Render complete ✓ 100%' pill, becomes the peak bar of a velocity histogram, then a 3D cube field, a particle galaxy, and finally the full stop of 'Claude.' with 'Motion designer | designing the in-between'. No cuts, very restrained, very premium.
fit_reason: Dark, quiet and precise with a single accent that becomes UI (toggle, progress pill, chart bar): exactly how a premium SaaS brand could carry one brand-colour dot through 'login → setup → done' without hype.

palette.mood: dark premium: near-black with a soft centre vignette, warm off-white type, one vermilion accent with soft glow

typography.display: clean geometric grotesk lowercase bold (Inter / Söhne Halbfett look) for 'motion', 'timing', the wordmark; elegant serif italic (Instrument Serif / Canela italic look) for 'feeling', 'velocity' and 'designing the in-between'; tiny mono HUD
typography.size_behaviour: one medium-large word centred at a time, lots of negative space
typography.notes: The orange dot replaces the tittle on i and is the wordmark's full stop. HUD: top-left section label (EASING, TYPOGRAPHY, INTERFACE, AVAILABLE FOR WORK), top-right 'CLAUDE · SHOWREEL · 26', bottom timecode, BPM, fps and a keyframe timeline with an orange progress line.

text_animation: letters rise from a baseline mask with slight blur and stagger (motion at 2.1 s)
the dot arcs in on a path and lands as the i's tittle at the end of the word build
word swap: one word blurs out as the next rises in, the dot stays put
serif italic word fades/rises in with blur
wordmark letters tumble in (claude) and settle into the title-case lockup
motion: dot travels along a visible cubic-bezier with handles and the value 'cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1)'
dot inflates into a toggle; toggle stretches into a progress pill that fills and shows a check
pill collapses into the peak bar of a histogram with a curve drawn over it
bars extrude into a 3D cube field, cubes dissolve into a particle field that swirls into a galaxy
everything on smooth ease-in-out, no bounce, soft orange glow
transitions: no cuts: shape continuity carries every scene (dot → letter dot → toggle → pill → bar → cubes → particles → full stop)
ui_treatment: micro-UI rebuilt as abstract elements (toggle, 'Render complete' pill) floating alone in the dark

sound.music: minimal electronic, ~120 BPM (in HUD), -13.9 LUFS, no voice
sound.sfx: subtle UI ticks likely on toggle/check

signature_moves: one accent dot that is the i-dot, the toggle, the progress pill, the chart peak and the full stop
sans word → italic serif word contrast ('timing' → 'feeling')
near-black canvas with HUD keyframe timeline

best_segments.what: Dot rides the bezier, lands as the i-dot of 'motion', word swaps to 'timing' then italic serif 'feeling' with the dot holding position.
Dot inflates into a toggle, then a 'Render complete ✓' pill, then becomes the peak bar of a velocity histogram.
Galaxy collapses, 'claude' tumbles in and settles as 'Claude.' with the orange full stop and serif-italic subline.

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP: one absolutely positioned div for the dot whose width/height/border-radius/position tween between states (toggle, pill, bar); words built with per-letter spans rising from overflow:hidden masks; MotionPath along an SVG bezier; histogram as divs; galaxy/cubes via canvas or Three.js (or drop them for SaaSSuite). Persistent HUD layer.
